description.description: What this agent does, in 3 to 5 words. It is the agent's name in lists and in the user's view.

prompt.description: The complete task for the agent, which sees nothing else of this conversation unless fork is set

subagent_type.description: general-purpose (default), Explore, Plan, or a type ListAgents shows

model.description: Model id or slot name; default: your model

isolation.description: Run in a git worktree of its own

team.description: Make it a member of this team: peers that message each other and share the task graph

fork.description: Start it with a copy of this conversation so far, on your model, instead of from nothing
